_comment: Redacted regression corpus for emulated tool calling on the Cloudflare Playground.
Every case is derived from a live capture in ~/.omniroute/call_logs (cloudflare-playground).
Absolute paths were replaced with /repo/..., file bodies with <redacted N chars>,
and the per-request nonce with NONCE. Shapes and tag nesting are untouched.
`expect.calls` is the ordered list of tool names the text actually declares.
`expect.finalize` is what finalizeCfToolCalls must return for those calls:
ok   -> a validated batch (arguments satisfy the declared schema)
null -> rejected, so the executor burns its one repair retry
`expect.malformed` is hasMalformedCfToolIntent for the same text.

cases.note: 2026-10-28T01:44 — <tool_call> around <tool name=read>, no closing wrapper. Parsed as edit before the fix.
A container must keep N nested calls as N calls, in document order.
A JSON body that merely CONTAINS markup must not be unwrapped as a container.
2026-10-27T13:16 — valid 11.7 KB write body closed with </path>.
Same defect with a read: the model closes with a different tag.
Name omitted; only read accepts {path}. Used to become availableTools[0] (edit).
{pattern} fits both glob and grep — refuse to guess and let the retry run.
2026-10-28T02:15 — the model copies the contract example tag and puts the intended tool in "arg". The real arguments are present, so honour them.
Same shape with no real arguments: nothing executable, so the repair retry must fire instead of calling edit.
2026-10-25T14:06 — name(key: value). Still not parsed, but it must NOT leak silently.
2026-10-27T13:19 — a checkpoint that talks about <write>. Correctly ignored.
